hints.title: Two Pointers Inward Scan
hints.text: Initialize left pointer at 0 and right pointer at length minus 1.

hints.title: Contract Identical Characters
hints.text: While left < right and characters match, advance left past all identical characters and retreat right past all identical characters.

hints.title: Remaining Window Length
hints.text: When characters at left and right diverge or pointers cross, return max(0, right - left + 1).

hints.title: Full Implementation

variables: n is length of string s
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Repeated string slicing takes O(n^2) quadratic time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Two-pointer inward contraction inspects each character at most once in O(n) time and O(1) space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate handles edge case where identical characters meet in the center (length reduces to 0).
